title: Coaching key to Alabama’s literacy success, report finds
summary: The state’s approach to placing a dedicated literacy coach in every school influenced the success seen later in Mississippi, a Fordham report says.

title: How to build an ‘attitude of gratitude’ across grade levels
summary: Helping students build skills around gratitude can have benefits ranging from daily mindset to overall classroom culture, a UC Berkeley professor says.

title: Increases in pre-K discipline rates alarm advocates
summary: Preschool enrollment grew just 12% between 2021-22 and 2023-24, but suspensions increased 67%, an analysis by two equity groups found.

title: More students are homeless as districts face enrollment and budget losses
summary: A report from SchoolHouse Connection shows 1 in 32 students were identified as homeless, the highest share on record.
